title: Visa TAP: checkout request and body object verification at the merchant
summary: The merchant verifies the agent-payer-auth signature, then each signed body object, then processes the payment data according to its processing path: credential hash for key entry, encrypted payload for API checkout.

steps.label: POST checkout with agent-payer-auth and body objects
steps.detail: Header signature plus agenticConsumer and agenticPaymentContainer, same key and nonce. The specification's examples pair an Ed25519 header with PS256 objects, which one key cannot produce; this example copies that pairing.

steps.label: Verify the header signature
steps.detail: Same steps as browsing: tag, minimum fields, window, nonce, key, signature.

steps.label: Consumer object: fields and nonce
steps.detail: Check nonce, idToken, contextualData, kid, alg and signature are present and the nonce equals the header nonce.

steps.label: Locate keys for kid and the ID Token
steps.detail: The same Visa key store serves the agent key and the key that verifies the ID Token JWS.

payload.content:
# The JWKS the TAP specification named until October 2026; the current page names no URL,
# and Visa's own code uses this JWKS's one RSA key to encrypt tokens for its MCP server.
GET /.well-known/jwks HTTP/1.1
Host: mcp.visa.com

steps.label: Verify consumer object and ID Token
steps.detail: Verify the object signature over the fields in the order received, then the ID Token, and map obfuscated contact values to accounts.

failures.outcome: Merchant may still use the data at its discretion

steps.label: Payment container: fields, nonce, key, signature
steps.detail: Check nonce, kid, alg and signature, compare the nonce, locate the key and verify.

failures.condition: Missing field, nonce mismatch or bad signature
failures.outcome: Should not be used for payment

steps.label: Process by type
steps.detail: Key entry: hash the typed card data and compare with the credential hash. API: decrypt payload with the merchant private key.
